report:
Updated diagnosis: Super Saturated (SS) hydration is independently repeated across three credited retailer-review actors (A04, A08, A13), under different conditions. A04 describes lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying hydration before makeup without perceived clogging; A08 reports hydration alongside tretinoin and other actives; A13 reports moisture retention through a 12-hour shift with oily T-zone/dry sensitive cheeks and mild rosacea. These support reported hydration, not measured efficacy or an independently repeated 12-hour effect. No direct SS hydration failure appears in this supplied set. A07's unavailable review body cannot support either direction.

A09 separately reports Avant Guard retaining hydration from SS, with poor fit on a very small head, especially around the nose, prompting a one-star deduction. This supports a joint mask–serum outcome; it does not isolate either product's contribution or add a direct SS hydration account.

Texture is mixed/conditional: A03 finds SS stickier than Wave but continues using SS because of its reportedly higher glycerin content, expressed uncertainly. A13 describes sticky, shiny, slick SS and accepts that feel for its benefits, sometimes wearing a pump outside; their assertion that most people should use it only at night is advice, not population evidence. A04 instead describes lightweight, fast-drying wear suited to makeup preparation. These descriptions can coexist, but application amount, routine and skin differences have not been shown to explain the variation. Stickiness recurs in two first-hand accounts across community and retailer roles, but A03's independence posture is unavailable, preventing confident cross-venue independent-origin credit. A17 merely speculates that Wave must be thinner: they explicitly have never tried Experiment because it does not ship to their location. Neither that speculation nor generic interest in hydrating serums corroborates SS experience.

Other-product boundaries matter. A10's overnight retention and glow concern Buffer Jelly; A14's silky jelly-to-oil texture and soft, calm skin concern gifted Buffer Jelly used twice with moisturizer. They cannot corroborate SS hydration or texture. A15 praises Plasma Wash's silky texture but reports inadequate cleansing, eye burning and increased dryness, especially after two washes. This opposes A04's favorable face-wash experience at the cleanser scope, not SS hydration. A18's exceptional hydration praise concerns Wave; its overnight retention failure and sunscreen pilling concern C.R.E.A.M. A17's C.R.E.A.M/Wave mixing practice and other-product experiences likewise remain outside SS evidence.

Explicit consequences: A04 narrates ordering SS after introduction by their sister, buying Buffer Jelly for greater nighttime hydration/repair, then buying face wash and immediately buying the mesh moisturizer. This is one actor's purchase narrative and brand enthusiasm, not proof that hydration independently caused every acquisition. A03 continues SS despite comparative stickiness. A13 accepts stickiness and adjusts willingness to wear it outside; no repurchase is narrated. A14 reports receiving a free product and becoming a brand convert, not purchasing or repurchasing. A15 considered returning Plasma Wash; no completed return or remedy is established. A09's rating penalty is explicit. Metadata labels such as verified buyer, First Time and Refill do not independently narrate buying or repeat purchases.

Engagement: every focal Junip review has 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes, observation time unavailable. Reddit native scores are A03=6, A17=7 and A18=10; each is explicitly marked material_positive=false and not_interpreted, with engagement observation time unavailable. No resonance promotion is warranted. Scores do not establish experiences, independence, prevalence or buying effects. Review update timestamps do not establish additional testimony or events. Exact formula versions remain unknown; named products and metadata variants do not establish formula continuity.

Material context, separately: product mappings resolve A08/A13 to SS, A09 to Avant Guard Small Head, A10/A14 to Buffer Jelly and A15 to Plasma Wash. A04 targets SS Refill; A07/A08 target SS First Time. Metadata describes A14 as rewarded=false despite the review's explicit free-product disclosure; preserve that discrepancy and the disclosure. Context-only hillary_____k reports buying Regimen Lab Level during Black Friday, brighter/even skin and a strong repurchase intention (2025-01-16; score 24), not an SS result or completed repurchase. Context-only Skin_Fanatic asks about C.R.E.A.M and says they have not tried it (2025-01-17; score 2). Their engagement observation times are unavailable. The shared Reddit post asks about Regimen Lab following Instagram advertising; its actor, date and engagement are unavailable here. These contexts supply no additional SS testimony. context_f05862db0ee1dcb8c8c6 repeats A18 exactly and is the same source, not another origin. A03/A17/A18 share one thread.

Stage limitation: only the updated stage and its 11 focal records are identified in the supplied request. Initial-stage membership and diagnosis are unavailable, so an exact initial-stage result or before/after change cannot be reconstructed without inventing the baseline. The counts below describe the supplied updated focal set; they count source accounts, not independent origins or real-world events.

source_index.findings: Iusedtobealawyer, Reddit, 2025-01-17: first-hand SS is stickier than Wave; continues SS because it has more glycerin, qualified by 'I think.' No direct hydration result or purchase/repurchase narrated. Native score 6, material_positive=false; independence unavailable. Shares thread with A17/A18. SS version unknown.

Junip actor 202931541, 2025-03-22: SS lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying and hydrating without perceived clogging, suitable before makeup. Ordered SS after sister's introduction; bought Buffer Jelly seeking greater nighttime hydration/repair, reporting glowing/clean skin; bought face wash, reporting makeup removal, hydration and no more breakouts; immediately bought mesh moisturizer. Strong brand/color enthusiasm accompanies purchases. Metadata: SS Refill, Combo + Sensitive, verified buyer; refill label alone proves no repurchase. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Junip actor 122992865, 2025-01-17: body is only 'undefined...'—usable testimony unavailable. Context identifies SS First Time, Combo skin and verified-buyer metadata, which cannot supply hydration, texture or acquisition testimony. Excluded from all requested counts. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Junip actor 152576810, 2024-02-02: age 51 with challenging skin; reports SS leaves skin hydrated when paired with tretinoin and other actives. Direct hydration report within a routine, not an isolated efficacy test; no texture or buying consequence narrated. Metadata: SS First Time, Combo + Acne Prone, verified buyer. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Metadata: Avant Guard Small Head, Dry + Acne Prone, verified buyer. No completed remedy or repurchase narrated. Votes 0/0; SS SKU/formula unknown.

Junip actor 97396127, 2023-07-21: context identifies Buffer Jelly; small amount as final nighttime step locks in hydrating products and yields morning glow. SS is not identified among those products; contributes no SS hydration/texture testimony. Metadata: Combo, verified buyer. No buying consequence narrated. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Junip actor 231128721, 2024-12-06: SS retention/plump hydration through a 12-hour shift; oily T-zone, dry sensitive cheeks and mild rosacea. Reports less irritation/reactivity, no forehead congestion and reduced oil production. Sticky, shiny, slick feel accepted alongside benefits; sometimes wears a pump outside, advises smaller amounts or night use. Advice/generalization and causal explanation exceed the individually observed outcomes. No repurchase narrated. Metadata: Oily + Sensitive, verified_buyer=false. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Junip actor 344086099, 2025-08-05: explicitly gifted Buffer Jelly, used twice; jelly becomes fluid oil with silky slip. A drop mixed into nighttime moisturizer reportedly yields soft skin without redness, irritation or clogged pores despite rosacea. Dermaplaning suitability and long bottle life are expectations, not tested results. Small-bottle concern is qualified by stated 1oz volume/reduced packaging; declares brand conversion, no purchase. Metadata rewarded=false conflicts with gift disclosure. No SS testimony. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Junip actor 210150638, 2024-11-04: Plasma Wash has beautiful silky texture but inadequate cleansing across amounts, wet/dry application and lathering methods; disappears without foam, burns eyes badly, leaves skin less clean/moisturized than favored glycerin cleanser and drier after two washes. Considered return; completion unknown. Unsure about defect versus misuse despite positive social-media reports. Contradicts favorable cleanser experience in A04, not SS. Votes 0/0; formula unknown.

Live_Rhubarb_7560, Reddit, 2025-01-17: likes Wave/glycerin and wants larger Wave bottles; infers Wave thinner than SS from stated 10% versus 30% glycerin. Explicit Experiment non-user due to shipping exclusion: speculative SS texture only. First-hand other-product details include Zerafite being more emollient/less pilling-prone than C.R.E.A.M yet thick/waxy, mixing Wave into C.R.E.A.M for easier use, and sometimes wanting an oily layer; favorable Azelaic tolerance, acceptable smell, dislike of Vit. X, adequate Level and favorable Tabula Rasa. None establishes SS experience. Score 7, material_positive=false; independence unavailable; same thread as A03/A18.

orchidmommy, Reddit, 2025-01-16: Wave is their most hydrating facial product; C.R.E.A.M retains moisture less well overnight than another moisturizer and pills under sunscreen, leading to stated dissatisfaction. No SS testimony or completed switching/return established. Score 10, material_positive=false; independence unavailable. Repeated verbatim in context_f05862db0ee1dcb8c8c6, same actor/source; shared thread with A03/A17.
